newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela pushes back date for third oil round.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela pushes back date for third oil round.

text.p: Venezuela's state-owned oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) has pushed back the date of its third oil licensing round from May to June 2-5, a spokeswoman said Tuesday.
The location has also been changed from the Caracas Hilton to the Hotel Tamanaco, Caracas, she added.
The contracts to operate the 20 fields has attracted widespread attention from domestic and foreign oil companies, with 259 companies "pre-qualifying" for the round.
Interested parties were meeting with PDVSA this week in a series of technical seminars to clarify legal and contractual terms, which are slightly different from previous rounds.
Current production from the fields totals 66,000 barrels per day, but PDVSA expects this to rise to 300,000 bpd in ten years time. Five of the 20 fields have been reserved for Venezuelan companies.
